en.title: thedotmack/claude-mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,600 | Your AI coding agent forgets everything between sessions, forcing you to repeat instructions. Claude-Mem solves this by running a **background observer** that takes notes on what your agent does, compresses it using AI, and injects **relevant context** back into future sessions. It works seamlessly with Claude Code, Cursor, and many other popular agents.
en.long_summary:
## Detailed Features
Claude-Mem is designed to solve the common frustration of AI agents forgetting past interactions. It automatically captures every tool call, file read, and edit during a session. A secondary observer agent processes this activity into **concise observations**, ensuring that your next session picks up right where you left off without burning excessive tokens.

## System Architecture & Search
The system relies on a token-efficient three-step workflow utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools: **search**, timeline, and get_observations. It stores structured sessions and observations in a local SQLite database, while leveraging Chroma for semantic vector search. A local worker service managed by Bun coordinates the background hooks and powers the web viewer interface.

## Installation & Usage
Getting started is simple. You can install the tool globally and set up your preferred agents by running **npx claude-mem** in your terminal. Once installed, it runs completely in the background without requiring manual intervention, keeping your project history structured and readily available across different development sessions.

zh.title: thedotmack/claude-mem：为每个 AI 代理提供跨会话的持久化上下文记忆
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,600 | 你的 AI 编程助手在每次新会话开始时都会“失忆”，导致你不得不反复重复指令。Claude-Mem 通过在后台运行一个**观察者代理**来记录它干了啥、用 AI 压缩重点，并在未来的会话中**自动注入**相关的上下文。它能完美兼容 Claude Code、Cursor 等各种主流编程助手。
zh.long_summary:
## 详细功能介绍
Claude-Mem 专门用来解决 AI 助手在会话之间“健忘”的痛点。它能在会话期间自动捕获每一个工具调用、文件读取和代码修改。后台的观察者代理会将这些活动处理成**精简的观察记录**，确保你的下一个会话能从上次中断的地方无缝衔接，同时不会消耗过多的 Token。

## 系统架构与搜索机制
该系统采用了一套基于 MCP（模型上下文协议）的高效三步工作流：**搜索**、时间线和获取详细观测。它将结构化的会话和观测数据存储在本地的 SQLite 数据库中，同时借助 Chroma 实现语义向量搜索。一个由 Bun 管理的本地后台服务负责协调钩子并驱动网页端查看器。

## 安装与使用说明
上手使用非常简单。你只需在终端中运行 **npx claude-mem** 命令即可完成安装并配置你常用的 AI 助手。安装完成后，它会在后台全自动运行，无需人工干预，让你的项目开发历史井井有条并在不同会话间持续传承。

en.title: Worktrunk: A Git Worktree CLI Built for Parallel AI Agents
en.summary: ⭐ 11,982 | Worktrunk is a command-line tool that makes **Git worktrees** as simple as regular branches. It solves the annoying complexity of managing multiple directories, letting you effortlessly run **parallel AI agents** like Claude Code at the same time without them stepping on each other's toes.
en.long_summary:
## What is Worktrunk?
Worktrunk is a CLI tool designed to streamline **Git worktree** management, especially tailored for workflows involving multiple parallel AI agents. Native Git worktrees are powerful because they give each task its own working directory, but the setup commands are notoriously clunky. Worktrunk cuts through this friction by mapping worktrees directly to **branch names** and automating the boring stuff.

## Core Commands and Features
With just a few intuitive commands, Worktrunk turns a multi-step chore into a breeze. You can use `wt switch` to create and jump into a worktree instantly, `wt list` to get a clean status overview of all ongoing tasks, and `wt merge` or `wt remove` to clean up afterwards. Beyond the basics, it offers killer features like **LLM commit messages**, automated hooks, interactive pickers, and shared build caches that save massive disk space and time.

## Installation and Getting Started
Installing Worktrunk is super straightforward. You can grab it via **Homebrew** on macOS and Linux using `brew install worktrunk`, or via Cargo, Winget, and Arch Linux package managers. Once installed, just run `wt config shell install` to enable directory-switching magic, and you are ready to spin up multiple parallel AI agents with commands like `wt switch -x claude -c feature-a`.

zh.title: Worktrunk：专为并行 AI 助手设计的 Git 工作区管理神器
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,982 | Worktrunk 是一个命令行小工具，它能像管理普通分支一样轻松管理 **Git 工作区**。它彻底解决了多目录操作繁琐的痛点，让你能同时爽快地运行多个 **并行 AI 助手**，再也不用担心它们互相打架了。
zh.long_summary:
## 这是个什么工具？
Worktrunk 是一个专门用来简化 **Git 工作区** 管理的命令行工具，特别适合需要同时开多个 AI 助手干活的开发场景。Git 原生的工作区功能虽然好用，能让每个任务拥有独立的目录，但操作命令实在太反人类了。Worktrunk 直接把工作区和 **分支名称** 绑定在了一起，帮你省去了各种繁琐的手动配置。

## 核心功能与亮点
通过几个简单的命令，Worktrunk 就能把原本复杂的操作变得像喝水一样自然。你可以用 `wt switch` 秒建并切换工作区，用 `wt list` 一目了然地查看所有任务的当前状态，或者用 `wt merge` 和 `wt remove` 一键合并与清理。除了基础功能，它还支持 **AI 自动提交信息**、工作流钩子、交互式选择器，甚至能共享构建缓存，帮你省下大量宝贵的硬盘空间。

## 如何安装与快速上手
安装非常简单，Mac 和 Linux 用户直接用 **Homebrew** 执行 `brew install worktrunk` 就能搞定，同时也支持 Cargo、Winget 等多种安装方式。装好后记得运行一下配置命令，接着你就可以用一行命令同时拉起好几个 AI 助手帮你并行写代码啦！

en.title: Wall Street suffers historic AI-driven tech plunge
en.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its worst session in months, **wiping out** over $2.5 trillion in market value as fears grew over an **AI bubble**. This massive drop was triggered by political shifts and mounting concerns over the **huge resource consumption** of data centers, reminding investors that AI growth faces real-world physical and regulatory limits.
en.long_summary:
## Market Crash and Political Triggers
On Thursday, the Nasdaq plummeted by 5.5 percent, marking its largest single-day point loss in history. This **historic drop** was catalyzed by the Democratic Party's victory in the midterm elections, which heightened fears of **tighter regulation** over artificial intelligence and data centers due to their massive electricity and water consumption.

## The Reality of Speculation
Before this correction, AI company valuations soared based on blind optimism rather than rational growth assessments. Investors poured massive amounts of borrowed money into computing infrastructure, ignoring mounting obstacles and **uncertain profitability**. 

## Broader Economic Risks
Because AI has recently become a major engine of the US economy, driving both corporate investments and consumer spending, a lasting loss of market confidence could trigger a **vicious cycle**. The correction is a much-needed reality check, proving that AI's future depends not just on billions of dollars, but on public acceptance and physical constraints.

zh.title: 华尔街遭遇AI泡沫破裂带来的历史性暴跌
zh.summary: 纳斯达克指数创下了几个月来最惨的一天，一天之内**蒸发市值**超过2.5万亿美元，引发了市场对**AI泡沫**要破裂的强烈担忧。这次大跌是由政治变动以及公众对数据中心**巨大资源消耗**的反对所触发的，给狂热的投资者敲响了警钟，提醒大家AI发展正面临现实中的物理和监管极限。
zh.long_summary:
## 股市暴跌与政治导火索
周四纳斯达克指数暴跌5.5%，创下了历史上单日点数跌幅之最。这次**历史性暴跌**的导火索是中期选举结果，它加剧了市场对人工智能面临**更严监管**的担忧。由于数据中心消耗大量的水和电力，地方反对声音日益高涨，让政策收紧的风险变得更加现实。

## 投机狂热与现实差距
在此次修正之前，AI公司的估值完全建立在盲目乐观而非理性的成长评估之上。投资者借来巨额资金疯狂涌入计算基础设施，却忽视了不断增加的建设阻力和**盈利的不确定性**。

## 更广泛的经济风险
由于AI最近已经成为美国经济的主要引擎之一，不仅推动了企业投资，还刺激了消费支出，因此市场信心的长期丧失可能会引发**恶性循环**。这次市场修正是一次及时的现实检验，证明了AI的未来不仅取决于砸下去的几十亿资金，更取决于公众的接受度和物理约束。

en.title: Silicon Valley Chinese Team Beats DeepSeek to Launch Next-Gen Agent Harness
en.summary: As DeepSeek proposes the concept of a **Super-agent**, a Silicon Valley Chinese team named AFK AI has already put a similar architecture into practice with their product **Comma**. By utilizing a single router and multiple independent workers, the system manages tasks across platforms, bypasses human attention bottlenecks, and brings long-term memory to AI agents.
en.long_summary:
The article explores the growing industry consensus around next-generation Agent Harnesses, specifically highlighting the convergence between DeepSeek's new Super-agent concept and the architecture built by Silicon Valley startup AFK AI in their product, Comma.

Traditionally, humans struggle to manage multiple AI chat sessions simultaneously due to a hard limit on personal attention. To solve this, both teams propose a 'single router with multiple workers' architecture. In this setup, a permanent main session handles overall coordination, while isolated sub-agents work in the background across various platforms like WeChat, Linear, and GitHub.

Furthermore, Comma tackles the challenge of agent memory and persistence. By storing long-term states outside the model context and continuously learning from user feedback to update smaller models, the system operates 24/7. This transition moves human interaction from micromanaging execution processes to simply overseeing final results.

zh.title: 抢跑DeepSeek！硅谷华人把下一代Agent Harness造出来了
zh.summary: 在大洋彼岸热议DeepSeek提出的超级智能体概念之际，一家硅谷华人团队早在半年前就将类似的架构落地到了产品**Comma**中。该系统通过主脑统筹和多任务并行执行，成功打破了人类注意力瓶颈，让AI能够跨平台**自主处理海量任务**。
zh.long_summary:
这篇文章聚焦于下一代AI智能体调度架构的演进，探讨了DeepSeek提出的超级智能体理念与硅谷华人团队AFK AI旗下产品Comma之间的不谋而合。

当前，人类同时跟进多个AI会话时会面临注意力上限的痛点。为了解决这一问题，行业顶尖玩家不约而同地指向了**主脑加多执行者**的底层架构。这意味着用户只需面对一个长期存在的主对话，由系统在后台调度多个独立的子智能体跨平台并行工作，无论是处理游戏开发、整理周报还是对接项目管理工具，都能一手包办。

在解决任务并发的同时，该系统还攻克了智能体长期记忆与全天候值守的难题。通过将状态保存在模型上下文之外，并利用人类反馈不断迭代专属小模型，AI得以在实际使用中**越用越聪明**。这种人机交互方式的转变，标志着人类终于从繁琐的盯盘过程中抽身，真正转向了只管结果的顶层决策。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Share 15 Design Patterns for AI Agent Systems
en.summary: GitHub, Google, and Siemens have pulled together **15 practical design patterns** for building multi-agent AI systems. These patterns help developers manage complex tasks, ensure reliable data flow, and **prevent AI agents from making mistakes** in real-world applications.
en.long_summary:
As AI agents move beyond simple chat bots into complex multi-agent systems, developers face massive challenges in task coordination and reliability. GitHub, Google, and Siemens have released detailed insights and architectural patterns to tackle these issues.

## GitHub's Approach to Structured Control
GitHub focuses on strict schemas and structured data flows. By enforcing strict JSON outputs, contract validation, and leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP), GitHub ensures that different agents can pass information smoothly without misinterpreting instructions.

## Google and Siemens' Insights on Error Recovery
Google and Siemens highlight patterns for handling failures and large-scale data integration. Google's 'Knowledge Fabric' and Siemens' code-generation projects demonstrate how breaking big jobs into smaller steps, maintaining human-in-the-loop validation, and implementing automatic retries are essential for robust agent operations.

zh.title: GitHub、Google与西门子联合整理：AI智能体系统的15个设计模式
zh.summary: GitHub、Google和西门子联合整理出了**15个实用设计模式**，专门用来教大家怎么设计多个AI协同工作的系统。这些套路能帮开发者搞定复杂任务、保证数据传输出错少，还能**防止AI在实际干活时频频翻车**。
zh.long_summary:
随着AI智能体从简单的聊天工具变成复杂的协同系统，怎么让多个AI有条不紊地一起干活成了大难题。GitHub、Google和西门子最近公开了它们在实践中总结出的宝贵经验，整理出了一套系统化的设计方案。

## GitHub的规范化控制与数据流
GitHub主要关注怎么用**严格的格式规范**来管好AI。通过强制要求JSON格式输出、使用契约验证以及借助MCP（Model Context Protocol）工具，GitHub确保了多个AI在传话和交接任务时不会出现误解，大大减少了出错的可能。

## Google与西门子的容错机制与大厂经验
Google和西门子则把重点放在了怎么应对错误和处理复杂的工程项目上。比如西门子在处理庞大的遗留代码时，通过把大任务切成小块、在关键节点加入**人工审查**以及设置自动重试机制，让AI在实际干活时变得更加靠谱和安全。

en.title: Can startup founders still find a way out in Personal Agent?
en.summary: Personal Agent has sparked a debate on whether it's just a game for tech giants, leaving no room for startups. However, its true value lies in growing **beyond the base model**, allowing products to build lasting trust and deep user understanding rather than just reselling AI tokens.
en.long_summary:
## The Shift Beyond Base Models
While tech giants leverage their massive capital, compute, and ecosystems to subsidize Personal Agents and harvest training data, startups face severe financial and technical bottlenecks, such as high cloud resource costs and unstable execution environments. However, the future of Personal AI may not be a winner-take-all market. Because human preferences are diverse and users are reluctant to hand over all personal data to a single corporation, Personal AI resembles a **consumer brand** rather than a monopoly platform.

## Finding a Viable Path
Startups can carve out a survival path by avoiding the generic trap and focusing on specific, high-value vertical scenarios. By turning tools into trusted partners, founders can build sustainable businesses if they carefully balance their resources and execution strategies instead of blindly burning cash for user scale.

zh.title: 创业者做 Personal Agent，有没有一线生机？
zh.summary: Personal Agent 把 AI 创业带到了新阶段，让很多人觉得这是大厂的游戏，创业者没戏。但它的核心价值在于能**长在基模外**，通过深度理解用户和建立长期信任，让创业公司有机会沉淀出不依赖大模型的自身资产。
zh.long_summary:
## 巨头的优势与创业者的困境
科技巨头拥有充沛的算力、流量和资金，可以把 Personal Agent 视为战略投入，通过补贴来收集宝贵的长任务执行轨迹。相比之下，创业公司由于需要向外购买模型和云资源，常常面临财务模型崩溃和基础设施不稳定的压力，甚至容易沦为模型厂商的打工仔。

## 赢家不通吃的垂直生机
Personal AI 的未来大概率不是赢家通吃。因为人的偏好各不相同，用户也不太可能把所有隐私全盘托付给单一巨头。创业者完全可以避开大而全的通用战场，选择在具体的垂直场景里切入，从一个好用的工具逐步走向用户的**思考伙伴**，在精细化运营中找到自己的生存空间。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker now supports Multi-Instance GPU to cut AI costs
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitioning, allowing users to divide a single physical GPU into independent slices. This helps **lower inference costs** and **maximize GPU utilization** by running multiple models on one device with hardware-level isolation.
en.long_summary:
## Background and Limitations
Previously, when deploying AI models to GPU endpoints on Amazon SageMaker, the smallest unit you could request was a whole accelerator. This forced companies into a dilemma: smaller models wasted massive amounts of unused GPU memory and compute, while older full GPUs struggled with growing workloads. Many enterprises had to resort to self-managed Kubernetes stacks just to get hardware partitioning.

## How MIG Works
Amazon SageMaker now natively integrates NVIDIA MIG, letting users split a single physical GPU into up to seven isolated instances. Each partition gets dedicated compute units, memory, and cache with strict **hardware-level isolation**. This ensures predictable latency, prevents one crashing model from taking down others, and eliminates cold starts since models stay permanently loaded.

## Performance and Cost Benefits
Testing showed that a single partition on a newer H100 GPU delivered significantly better performance and lower latency than a whole older A100 GPU while being **18 to 34 percent cheaper** per million output tokens for high-concurrency and long-context tasks. SageMaker manages the configuration and scaling automatically, removing the heavy platform engineering work.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 支持多实例 GPU，帮企业省钱提效
zh.summary: 亚马逊 SageMaker 现在支持英伟达的多实例 GPU 分割技术，允许把一块完整的显卡拆成多个独立的小份。这项功能解决了过去小模型只能独占整张卡造成的资源浪费，能帮企业**大幅降低成本**并**提高显卡利用率**。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景与痛点
以往在亚马逊 SageMaker 上部署 AI 模型时，最少只能申请一整张显卡。这导致很多中小型模型根本用不完所有的算力和显存，白白浪费了资源；而如果遇到并发需求变高，老旧的整卡又往往不够用。过去企业如果想把一张显卡拆成多份来用，只能自己去搭建和维护复杂的 Kubernetes 集群，非常折腾。

## 技术原理与优势
现在 SageMaker 直接内置了英伟达的多实例 GPU 技术，能把一块物理显卡安全地拆成最多七个独立的小卡。每个小卡都有自己专属的算力和显存，做到了**硬件级别的隔离**。这样一来，不仅不同模型之间不会互相干扰、崩了一个不影响另一个，而且模型可以一直保持加载状态，彻底消除了冷启动的延迟。

## 实际效果与成本
测试表明，用更新、更强显卡的一个切片去跑模型，不仅在速度和响应时间上全面超越了老旧的整张显卡，而且在处理大并发和长文本时，每百万输出 tokens 的**成本能降低 18% 到 34%**。最重要的是，这一切都由 SageMaker 自动搞定，用户再也不用自己去维护底层平台了。

en.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **ToyBlocks**, an open simulation framework designed to help robots learn and practice manipulation tasks like stacking and sorting. By using a controlled virtual environment with realistic physics, the system can automatically generate massive amounts of training data without human remote control. This allows scientists to easily test how different AI models handle spatial reasoning, plan multi-step actions, and eventually transfer those skills to **real-world robots**.
en.long_summary:
## 背景与动机
Robots are rapidly learning physical tasks, but traditional training often relies on narrow demonstrations that make it hard to trace why a model fails. To solve this, researchers built ToyBlocks as the first **FoundationWorld**—a controlled, simulated environment aimed at studying robotics in a simplified setting where conditions can be easily tweaked and repeated.

## 核心细节与测试
ToyBlocks uses Nvidia's Isaac Lab and reinforcement learning to automatically generate skills like pushing and flipping blocks. It scales data generation by running hundreds of plans in parallel on a single GPU. Researchers tested various AI setups, including low-level action models (VLAs), high-level vision-language models like Molmo 2, and agentic systems powered by Claude, evaluating their ability to generalize to unseen spatial layouts and **spell words with blocks**.

## 实际影响与未来
Crucially, policies trained entirely in ToyBlocks were deployed zero-shot on a physical Franka robot, showing similar success rates between simulation and reality. The framework is now **fully open-sourced**, providing massive datasets and simulation assets to help the global research community advance robot learning.

zh.title: ToyBlocks：一个专为机器人学习与评估打造的虚拟训练场
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了名为 **ToyBlocks** 的开源仿真框架，专门用来帮助机器人学习抓取、堆叠和分类等日常操作。通过建立一个物理规则逼真的虚拟环境，该系统可以自动生成海量训练数据，省去了人工远程遥控的麻烦。这让科学家们能够轻松测试不同的AI模型如何进行空间推理、规划长步骤动作，并最终把这些技能顺利应用到 **真实世界的机器人** 身上。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景与动机 机器人正在快速学习各种物理操作，但传统的训练方式往往比较局限，很难弄清楚模型为什么会失败。为了解决这个问题，研究人员打造了 ToyBlocks，作为首个“基础世界”（FoundationWorld）——这是一个受控的模拟环境，能让科学家在简化且可控的条件下研究机器人行为，随时复现和调整测试条件。 ## 核心细节与测试 ToyBlocks 利用英伟达的 Isaac Lab 和强化学习技术，自动生成推动、翻转方块等基础技能，并通过单张显卡并行运行数百个任务来高效产生数据。研究团队利用该框架测试了多种AI架构，包括底层动作模型、像 Molmo 2 这样的大型视觉语言模型，以及由 Claude 驱动的智能体系统，重点评估了它们在空间泛化、多步骤规划以及**拼字任务**上的表现。
## 实际影响与未来 最重要的是，完全在 ToyBlocks 仿真中训练出来的策略被直接部署到了真实的机械臂上，并在虚拟与现实中展现出高度一致的成功率。目前，该框架已经**完全开源**，并附带了海量的数据集和仿真资产，旨在帮助全球研究人员推动通用机器人技术的进步。

en.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
en.summary: NVIDIA's open source 5G and 6G tools, including Aerial and Sionna, have surged past **1 million downloads** globally as researchers use them to develop AI-native networks. These platforms are enabling breakthroughs like **faster-reacting robots** and smarter signal reception to shape the future of wireless connectivity.
en.long_summary:
Over the past year, global developer adoption of NVIDIA AI Aerial and Sionna has grown 10x, with over 8,000 research and academic institutions now using these open source platforms. Researchers are tackling key wireless challenges by combining simulation and AI training with real-world experiments.

At King’s College London, researchers used NVIDIA Sionna to enable **goal-oriented semantic communications**, allowing a robot arm to transmit compact descriptions instead of full images, which reduced task completion time by up to 52.6%. Meanwhile, SoftBank and ETH Zurich demonstrated that AI-powered receivers can significantly improve signal recovery under heavy interference.

Additionally, researchers at the University of Leeds used a portable 5G setup to **reduce base station power consumption** by 45.6% using demand forecasting, while CTTC accelerated network simulation runtimes from three hours down to 10-20 minutes using GPU acceleration. These innovations point toward a future where 6G networks deliver seamless connectivity, computing, and sensing for billions of devices.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具如何帮助研究人员打造下一代6G网络
zh.summary: 英伟达的5G和6G开源工具（如Aerial和Sionna）全球下载量已突破**100万次**，世界各地的研究人员正用它们来开发人工智能原生的网络。这些平台正在带来重大突破，比如让**机器人反应更快**以及实现更智能的信号接收，从而塑造无线连接的未来。
zh.long_summary:
在过去的一年里，全球开发者对英伟达AI Aerial和Sionna软件的使用量增长了10倍，已有超过8000家研究和学术机构正在使用这些开源平台。研究人员通过将模拟仿真、AI训练与真实世界的无线实验结合，正在攻克多项无线通信的行业难题。

在伦敦国王学院，研究人员利用英伟达Sionna实现了**目标导向的语义通信**，让机器人手臂只需传输精简的对象描述而不是整张图片，从而将任务完成时间缩短了多达52.6%。同时，软银集团和苏黎世联邦理工学院的研究表明，人工智能接收器可以在严重的干扰下大幅提升信号恢复能力。

此外，利兹大学的研究人员利用便携式5G设备通过需求预测将**基站功耗降低了45.6%**，加泰罗尼亚电信技术中心则利用GPU加速将网络模拟运行时间从3小时缩短至10到20分钟。这些创新共同指向了一个未来，即6G网络将为数十亿设备提供无缝的连接、计算和感知能力。

en.title: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
en.summary: I tested the new AI-powered tool from NYT Cooking on ingredient swaps and recipe scaling. It helped me **modify recipes** on the fly when I lacked ingredients, but it also nearly messed up my baking measurements. As a **handy kitchen helper**, it is useful for quick fixes, but you still need to keep a close eye on it.
en.long_summary:
The NYT Cooking app has introduced an AI assistant designed to help users customize recipes on the fly, offering substitutions for missing ingredients, scaling portions, and converting measurements directly within the recipe page. During hands-on testing, the AI successfully adapted a chicken and rice recipe based on available fridge items, validated spice swaps, and even politely declined a ridiculous request to put beef in a dessert trifle. However, baking proved trickier, as confusion between the original recipe and the AI-modified version nearly led to using too little butter in a cake.

While recipe purists may scoff at altering expert-tested dishes, the AI essentially automates the process of digging through hundreds of reader comments for substitution tips. It outperforms smart home voice assistants like Alexa in displaying modified text on screen, though physical navigation with garlicky fingers remains a messy challenge. Ultimately, the AI works well as a **digital sous chef**, saving trips to the grocery store for missing items, provided the human cook stays in charge as the head chef.

zh.title: 纽约时报烹饪AI助手能帮你想晚饭，但差点毁了我的蛋糕
zh.summary: 我实测了《纽约时报》烹饪应用的AI新功能，用来临时换食材和调整分量。它能帮我快速**修改食谱**，把冰箱里现有的鸡肉变成一盘好菜，但在烘焙时差点搞错黄油分量。作为一个**厨房小帮手**，它用起来确实省事，但你可千万别完全甩手不管。
zh.long_summary:
《纽约时报》的烹饪应用最近上线了一款AI助手，专门帮用户在看食谱时直接现场魔改。不管是缺了某种食材想换掉、需要按人数缩放分量，还是转换计量单位，它都能在页面上直接搞定。在实际测试中，这个AI成功根据冰箱里剩的食材改造了一道鸡肉饭，还很机智地拒绝了把碎牛肉放进甜点里的奇葩要求。不过，烘焙就没那么顺利了，因为在原版和AI修改版之间切来切去，差点让它把蛋糕的黄油用量给算错。

虽然有些追求原汁原味的烹饪爱好者对这种AI改食谱的做法不屑一顾，但它实际上帮大家省去了在几百条读者评论里翻找替代食材的麻烦。比起只能靠语音播报的智能音箱，它直接在屏幕上显示修改后食谱的做法明显更直观。总的来说，这个AI是个称职的**数字帮厨**，能帮你省下跑一趟超市的时间，前提是你自己得把好关，别当甩手掌柜。

en.title: US Midterms Spell Trouble for Tech Giants and Data Centers
en.summary: Democrats' big wins in the midterm elections and local votes against data centers mean **tougher times ahead** for tech companies. Even heavy donors like **Elon Musk** are facing a newly elected political landscape that wants to restrict data centers. In response, AI firms like **OpenAI** are already rushing to change their secret ways and rebrand data centers as compute campuses.
en.long_summary:
## Election Impact
The recent midterm elections have brought significant political shifts, notably in states like Texas where newly elected leaders campaigned on restricting data centers. Tech analysts point out that despite massive political donations, figures like **Elon Musk** find themselves with businesses headquartered in regions moving in the opposite political direction.

## Grassroots Pushback
Public opposition to data centers has turned into a powerful grassroots movement. Citizens are frustrated by the **secretive approval processes** and non-disclosure agreements forced on local officials, especially in environmentally sensitive areas facing water shortages.

## Industry Response
In the face of mounting political pressure, AI companies are starting to bend. **OpenAI** recently released a new policy blueprint promising transparency, dropping non-disclosure requirements, and even trying to rebrand traditional data centers as **compute campuses** to soften their public image.

zh.title: 美国中期选举后，科技巨头和数据中心要头疼了
zh.summary: 美国中期选举后民主党的大胜，加上各地投票反对建设数据中心，意味着科技公司**好日子到头了**。就连砸重金支持共和党的大佬**马斯克**，现在也得面对一个急于限制数据中心的新政治环境。为了应对压力，像**OpenAI**这样的AI公司已经开始放弃暗箱操作，甚至试图把数据中心改名叫算力园区来挽回形象。
zh.long_summary:
## 选举带来的政治压力
近期美国中期选举带来了明显的政治格局变化，比如得克萨斯州等地的全新领导人正是靠着限制数据中心的口号赢得选举。科技观察人士指出，尽管此前砸下巨资进行政治捐款，但像**马斯克**这样的大佬发现，自己的公司总部反而落在了政治风向大变的地区。

## 基层民众强烈反对
民众对数据中心的厌烦已经演变成了一股强大的民间力量。大家极为不满企业在推进项目时的**暗箱操作**，以及强迫地方官员签署保密协议的做法，尤其是在那些面临水资源短缺的生态敏感地区。

## 科技行业的应对
面对扑面而来的监管压力和政治阻力，AI公司开始做出妥协。**OpenAI**最近发布了一份新政策蓝图，承诺放弃保密要求并保持透明，甚至试图把传统的数据中心重新包装成**算力园区**，希望能改善公众对它们的负面印象。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using Sibling Execution Environments
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **Harness-S**, a clever training method to make AI agents more reliable. Instead of looking for a single perfect execution environment, it creates a pool of specialized "sibling" environments to help **rescue failed tasks**. When the main environment fails, these helpers step in, and their success is eventually **taught back to the AI**, making the original system much stronger.
en.long_summary:
Training AI agents usually relies on a single execution harness, but different tweaks fix some problems while breaking others. Harness-S addresses this by developing a pool of specialized sibling harnesses that evolve along distinct repair directions. When initial attempts in the base harness fail, the system invokes this pool, uses auxiliary environments to generate successful trajectories, and **transfers these new capabilities** back into a single policy through reinforcement learning.

An Adaptive Harness Router selects the best variants using behavior profiles and LLM voting, dynamically adjusting as the AI learns. Tests across benchmarks like AppWorld, SWE-Gym, and DBBench show that models trained with Harness-S **substantially outperform** standard training methods when returning to the original base harness, proving that helper environments can effectively teach the core AI new tricks.

zh.title: Harness-S：利用“兄弟环境”帮 AI 变得更聪明
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了一种名为 **Harness-S** 的新训练方法，能让 AI 助手变得更靠谱。它不去找一个完美的运行环境，而是准备了一堆不同特长的“兄弟环境”来**帮忙救场**。当主力环境搞不定时，这些助手就会上阵，最后把成功的经验**教给 AI**，让它在原本的环境里也能表现得更好。
zh.long_summary:
训练 AI 助手通常依赖单一的运行环境，但微调往往是修好了这个漏洞又引发那个问题。Harness-S 提出了一套新思路：通过开发一组专长各异的“兄弟环境”来解决这个问题。当基础环境处理失败时，系统会召唤这些辅助环境来救场，产生成功的操作轨迹，并通过强化学习把这些**新能力教给 AI**。

系统内置了一个智能路由器，利用行为画像和多个大模型的投票来挑选最合适的辅助环境，并随着 AI 的学习不断更新。在多个基准测试中的表现证明，使用 Harness-S 训练出来的模型在回到原基础环境时，**成绩大幅超越**传统训练方法，证明了辅助环境确实能有效提升 AI 的核心能力。
